Hector (Sales): handing off ApexCare to CS. 3-month pilot, 4 seats, EU data residency. They want Okta SSO, Splunk audit forwarding, and a private eval in eu-west. Renewal ~10 months. Lena, can you lead? Contract: https://redwood.at/apexcare-pilot

Lena (CS): I can. who's the technical contact and any immediate compliance flags?

Hector (Sales): tech contact is 'Ruth Chang' (ruth@apexcare.health). Pilot uses synthetic data but they're asking about HIPAA readiness long-term. Please tag security.

Kai (Infra): for private eval we need CIDRs, peering type, and mTLS cert. Splunk HEC requires egress to collector.apexcare.health:8088 and their token.

Ravi (Support Eng): Splunk prefers JSON. I'll draft a minimal S3->Splunk mapping and a quick troubleshooting checklist (HEC token, cert chain, firewall). Any preferred kickoff windows (CET)?

Maya (Onboarding PM): I can schedule. Suggest 25-min tech kickoff + 45-min enablement. Tue or Thu morning CET?

Lena (CS): Tue AM works. Proposed owners:
1) Collect CIDRs + certs + Splunk token (owner: Ruth / ApexCare)
2) Confirm Okta metadata (owner: Hector)
3) Provision private eval in eu-west (owner: Kai)
4) Draft pilot feedback doc + success metrics (owner: Lena)
5) Schedule kickoff (owner: Maya)

Hector (Sales): noted. Ruth said she'll send assets by EOD tomorrow.
